description: Source code for a Zephyr-based Bluetooth Mesh remote provisioning shell commands and report handling, including scan, provisioning, and link management functions.

methods.name: rpr_scan_report
methods.description: Callback function to handle scan reports, printing UUID, OOB info, and adv data.

methods.name: cmd_scan
methods.description: Starts a scan with a specified timeout and optional UUID filter.

methods.name: cmd_scan_ext
methods.description: Starts an extended scan with additional advertising data types.

methods.name: cmd_scan_srv
methods.description: Starts a scan for specific advertising data types.

methods.name: cmd_scan_caps
methods.description: Retrieves scan capabilities of a remote provisioning node.

methods.name: cmd_link_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current provisioning link status.

methods.name: cmd_provision_remote
methods.description: Starts remote provisioning with specified UUID, NetKey index, and address.

methods.name: cmd_reprovision_remote
methods.description: Reprovisions a remote node at a given address, optionally with a changed composition.
